AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Grafting in Plants 13 4.2 Homemade Sun Dryer 13 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Grafting in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Homemade Sun Dryer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Animal Feed: Hay and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Leftover Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
